source_hierarchy.rule: Gemini controls layout and priority; photos control identity and materials; the Art Bible controls pixel discipline.

technical_contract.shared_negative_prompt: isometric, oblique, three-quarter furniture, side view, eye-level view, horizon, vanishing point, converging perspective, dominant front face, soft painting, antialiasing, blur, glow halo, noisy single pixels, text, labels, watermark, cast shadow outside canvas

pixellab_request_mapping.description: Concatenate sprite_ledger[].description, the matching orientation rule, the visible-bounds instruction, and technical_contract.shared_negative_prompt prefixed with 'Avoid:'.
pixellab_request_mapping.note: PixelLab has no separate negative_prompt field for create_map_object; negative constraints must be appended to description.

orientation.floor_plan_rule: Top surfaces dominate. Local north matches room north. A 1-3 px near-side depth edge is allowed only for readability.
orientation.vertical_fixture_rule: Windows, curtains, wall art, flag, doors, wall shelves, and tall cat-tree trunk may use a front-elevation overlay while their floor contact stays grid-aligned.

atlas.packing_rule: Each atlas cell is 16x16. Unused cells remain transparent.

walkable_spine.exit_route: Keep a clear route from the bed's south edge through the rug's east edge to the east-wall door.

arguments.floor_description: warm Australian timber floorboards, narrow varied honey and chestnut planks, restrained seams, clean low-detail hard-edged pixel art
arguments.wall_description: soft warm off-white plaster wall with restrained cool dawn-grey shadow and simple timber baseboard, low-detail hard-edged pixel art

acceptance: wall boundaries cover all cardinal edges and corners

arguments.lower_description: warm honey and chestnut timber plank floor, clean low-detail hard-edged pixel art
arguments.upper_description: flat cream woven rug with repeated tan and muted blue-grey geometric grid motifs, no perspective
arguments.transition_description: short cream woven fringe at the rug edge, grid-aligned and restrained

acceptance: no fringe on interior rug cells

sprite_ledger.description: Wide three-panel glazed window or glass door for the north wall, high top-down room with a modular front-elevation wall overlay, slim dark frames, sheer white curtains gathered mostly left, pale blue Melbourne-like city silhouettes outside. Flat low-detail pixel clusters, no readable logos or text. Geometry identical between variants; night changes only the outside layer.

Strict 90-degree high top-down plan-view deep cobalt blue futon-bed, headboard on north edge, carved warm timber rails, two pale cream pillows, loose cream throw and one bright orange cushion. Top surfaces dominate; at most a two-pixel south depth edge. Cozy lived-in silhouette matching the Gemini tutorial room, transparent background.

Perfectly flat rectangular cream woven rug seen at 90 degrees overhead, repeated tan and muted blue-grey geometric grid inspired by the real rug and Gemini room, short cream fringe only on north and south edges, hard-edged low-detail pixel art, transparent background, no perspective trapezoid.

Square dark warm-wood dining and work table, strict 90-degree high top-down plan view, broad uncluttered tabletop with east-west wood grain and four subtle leg hints contained underneath, transparent background, no pendant lamp baked in, no visible front cabinet face.

One light honey timber dining chair with woven cane seat and cane back, strict high top-down plan view. Produce coherent north, east, south, and west facing variants with identical proportions and lighting from north-west. Top of seat and thin back rail readable; no oblique side view.

Round white Japanese paper pendant lamp seen directly from below as a near-perfect circle, sparse curved rib lines and a tiny dark central cord point, flat hard-edged pixel art. Warm-lit variant has a compact cream-gold core but no soft alpha glow baked into the sprite.

Tall green carpeted cat tree based on the real room: central sisal-covered trunk, several offset round platforms and two warm tan plush basket beds. In the Gemini silhouette it resembles a cactus, but every branch must clearly be a cat platform. High top-down vertical-fixture treatment, top surfaces of platforms visible, base grid-aligned, transparent background.

Low rectangular dark carved wooden storage chest based on the real entrance chest, strict high top-down plan view, ornate floral carving simplified into coherent pixel clusters on the lid, tiny brass latch on south edge, no readable text, transparent background. Open state preserves footprint and hinge on north edge.

Plain warm-white apartment exit door with simple timber edge and small brass hardware, modular east-wall vertical fixture. Coherent closed, 45-degree open, 90-degree open, and empty-frame states. High top-down room convention, no eye-level hallway perspective.

Large vertically hung Filipino flag-inspired household banner from the real room and Gemini composition: blue upper field, red lower field, white hoist triangle, simplified golden sun and three stars. Front-elevation wall overlay, respectful clear geometry, no writing, hard-edged pixel art.

Freestanding slim metal clothes rack crowded with real-room dark jackets plus readable coral-orange, muted pink, grey, and cream garments. Rail runs east-west against west wall. High top-down vertical-fixture treatment with hanger tops and garment shoulders visible, base feet grid-aligned, transparent background.

Modular wall dressing sheet: two narrow warm-wood floating shelves, compact black wire book basket, small stacks of coloured books, headphones, framed calligraphy represented as abstract ink clusters, Buddhist/Japanese art and an illustrated landscape. No legible text or fake glyph strings; simple front-elevation wall overlays.

Coherent set of three real-room foliage props: small bright leafy plant in woven basket, large feathery palm in dark pot, and trailing pothos in woven hanging basket. High top-down view with pot openings and leaf crowns dominant, low-detail coherent clusters, transparent background.

Three separate small household pet props matching the photographs: shallow cream oval pet bed, small round stainless-steel bowl, and grey cylindrical wastebasket with warm round timber lid. Strict overhead plan view, recognisable at 1x, transparent background, each item separable on the 16px grid.
Small rumpled purple hoodie lying flat on timber floor, sleeves splayed and hood readable, strict overhead silhouette, using the Mango purple ramp, transparent background, no body inside it.

Tiny orange tabby Mango curled asleep clockwise on the blue bed, strict overhead view, head tucked toward south, readable ears and striped tail ring, 8-10 colours maximum, matches the 20x16 overworld abstraction and warm orange palette, transparent background, no clothing.
